author: agent
text:
Re-read after 0.54.0, module-level comments checked against the code as it now stands.

What 0.54.0 added here, all of it new since the confirms below: SKETCH_VERSION (the generation of the shingle hash, distinct from PARSE_SCHEMA_VERSION - that one invalidates the parse CACHE and so recomputes the new side, this one describes sketches already written into coordinates.json which CANNOT be recomputed because the old source text is gone); stored_sketch_version(), which reads 1 when the stamp is absent, never "current", so a pre-0.54 map cannot claim comparability it does not have; and record_sketch_version(), additive to the manifest in the same style as freshness's indexed_at_sha.

The earlier confirms remain accurate in substance - the module docstring correction about handling more than Python still holds, and the _structure_hash rename review still holds. They went stale because the module's behaviour moved underneath them, not because they were wrong.

One standing hazard for whoever edits next: anything persisted into coordinates.json must be reproducible by a different process on a different machine. Builtin hash(), id(), set-iteration order, and dict ordering that leaks into a written list are all disqualified. tests/test_determinism.py holds the line by indexing one tree from two processes and requiring byte-identical output, and it deliberately does NOT pin PYTHONHASHSEED - pinning it is what hid the original bug for a year.

author: agent
text:
Re-read after 0.54.1. Module-level comments checked against the code as it stands; the confirms below remain accurate in substance and went stale because the module moved under them.

Since the last confirm: index() gained the keyword-only persist flag (see the Indexer confirm for why it is keyword-only with 41 callers). Everything 0.54.0 introduced is unchanged - SKETCH_VERSION = 2, stored_sketch_version() reading 1 when the stamp is absent rather than "current", and record_sketch_version() writing additively to the manifest.

The distinction between the two version constants is the thing to keep straight, because they look interchangeable and are not: PARSE_SCHEMA_VERSION invalidates the parse CACHE, so it recomputes the NEW side of a comparison; SKETCH_VERSION describes sketches already written into coordinates.json, which CANNOT be recomputed because the old source text is gone. That asymmetry is why lineage refuses the minhash signal across a generation boundary instead of scoring it zero.

Standing hazard, unchanged and worth restating on every pass through this module: anything persisted here must be reproducible by a different process on a different machine.

author: cli
text: Re-read after 0.54.3. The module's confirms below still hold. One addition worth knowing at module level: the on-disk formats this module writes are now READ forward-compatibly - load_raw_edges filters unknown keys instead of dying on them. A schema addition used to break any process running an older build the instant a newer one re-indexed, which is exactly the class of failure the sketch_version stamp was introduced to prevent on the other side: absent means old, unknown means ignore, neither means crash.
